body:
colors.py:26: _c() gates ANSI codes on sys.stdout.isatty(), but warn()/error() output is printed to stderr (commands.py, tracker.py, remote_sync.py).

Consequences:
- `gittoc list > file` drops warning colors a human would still see on the terminal
- `gittoc ... 2> log` writes ANSI escapes into the log while stdout is a TTY

Fix: make color decisions per destination stream (e.g. _c gains a stream param, or warn/error check sys.stderr.isatty()). While in there, honor the informal NO_COLOR standard (https://no-color.org/): any non-empty NO_COLOR env var disables colors everywhere.
title: Color stderr output based on stderr TTY and honor NO_COLOR
